From May 20, 2024 through October 18, 2024, representatives of the Pipeline and Hazardous
Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Pipeline Safety (OPS), pursuant to Chapter
601 of 49 United States Code (U.S.C.) performed an on-site inspection of St Louis Pipeline
Operating, LLC’s (SLPCO) refined petroleum pipeline system, in Madison County, Illinois and
St Louis County, Missouri.
As a result of the inspection, it is alleged that SLPCO has committed a probable violations of the
Pipeline Safety Regulations, Title 49, Code of Federal Regulations (CFR). The item inspected
and the probable violation is:

§ 195.420 Valve maintenance.
